brokenAt.description: audit_digests.id of the segment that diverged (present when ok=false).

ok.description: True when the hash chain over entitlement_events verifies intact.

results.description: One entry per input id (in input order). `ok:false` rows carry a per-row failure code (not_found, revoked_entitlement_is_terminal, stale_transition, invalid_entitlement_id, mutation_failed).

BatchTransitionInput.description: Bulk transition body. `reason` is required (non-empty) for disable/revoke. `ids` is the encoded entitlement ids (1..4); a larger batch is rejected before any D1 query or mutation, with recovery guidance in the error data.

reason.description: Required (non-empty) for disable/revoke; ignored for reenable.

CatalogImportApplyInput.description: Apply exactly one server-persisted catalog import preview. A manifest in an Apply request is rejected with preview_required.

effective_at.description: Single timestamp used for every imported catalog row and audit transition.

manifest_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the normalized manifest held by the server.

preview_id.description: Opaque, short-lived, actor-bound catalog import capability. Apply accepts this value only.

source_generation.description: Conservative catalog generation that must still match at Apply.

guidance.const: narrow the manifest and preview again

account_tokens.description: token_hmac and pepper_key_id are deliberately never returned.

items.description: The entitlement's device keys, newest-touched first (max 200).

EmptyBody.description: Empty JSON object (`{}`). An empty request body is also accepted.

guidance.const: split the request into batches of at most 4 entitlement ids

EntitlementDevice.description: A registered relay-resistance device key (entitlement_devices). The public key is not surfaced here.

last_seen_at.description: Last time this device presented a valid request proof (null if never).

device_hash.description: 64-char hex, or empty string for unbound.

policy_id.description: Optional. When present (and non-empty), the entitlement is STAMPED from this policy template instead of validated directly. Requires POLICY_STAMP_MODE=on (else 400 policy_stamping_disabled); the policy must exist and be active (else 404 policy_not_found). Body fields above act as per-field overrides on the stamp.

valid_from.description: Epoch seconds; must be < valid_until when both set.

valid_until.description: Epoch seconds; must be > valid_from when both set.

EntitlementPatch.description: All fields optional; only provided fields are updated. project/feature/license_fingerprint/status are NOT patchable.

is_trial.description: 1 when stamped from a trial policy, else 0. Frozen on the row.

policy_id.description: Advisory provenance: the policy this row was stamped from (frozen; no live link).

reason.description: Optional; required (non-empty) when status is disabled or revoked.

days_left.description: ceil((valid_until - now)/86400); >=1 for a still-future expiry.

valid_until.description: Epoch seconds the entitlement expires at.

period_start.description: Unix seconds; start of the current period.

units_consumed.description: Units consumed in the current period (0 if none yet). Reading this does NOT increment it.

PlanProjectionApplyInput.description: Apply exactly one server-persisted preview. Catalog/form fields are intentionally not accepted here.

PlanProjectionInput.description: Plan assignment/projection request. `plan_id` or `plan_key` is required. The plan is expanded into concrete feature entitlements; runtime checks do not read tier names.

addons.description: Optional add-on keys exposed by the selected plan.

plan_id.description: Catalog plan id. Required when plan_key is omitted.

plan_key.description: Catalog plan key. Required when plan_id is omitted.

support_until.description: Optional support/subscription window override stamped onto desired entitlements. Must be a safe epoch second no later than 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z.

effective_at.description: Single timestamp used to derive time-relative policy fields.

preview_id.description: Opaque, short-lived server-bound preview capability. Apply accepts this value only.

source_generation.description: Conservative catalog-projection dependency generation bound to this preview.

Policy.description: A license-policy template (entitlement_policies row). Frozen at stamp time onto a new entitlement.

meter_period_sec.description: Rolling metering period length in seconds (0 -> the 30d default).

meter_quota.description: Per-period consumption quota (0 = unlimited/count-only). A stamped entitlement inherits it.

PolicyInput.description: Create body. project/name/type required; every other field takes the column default. Explicit node_locked policies require pool_size=0; explicit floating policies require pool_size>0.

meter_period_sec.description: Rolling metering period length in seconds.

name.description: Unique per project (case-insensitive). A duplicate returns 409 policy_name_conflict.

pool_size.description: Capacity source of truth. node_locked requires 0; floating requires a value greater than 0.

PolicyPatch.description: All fields optional; only provided fields are updated. project/name/type/status are NOT patchable (status flips only via disable/reenable). A pool_size patch must preserve the existing policy type's node_locked/floating invariant.

meter_period_sec.description: Rolling metering period length in seconds (0 -> the 30d default).

meter_quota.description: Per-period consumption quota (0 = unlimited/count-only). A stamped entitlement inherits it.

pool_size.description: Capacity source of truth. node_locked policies cannot be patched above 0; floating policies cannot be patched to 0.

reason.description: Required audit reason. Must not contain newlines or NUL. Empty/missing returns 400 reason_required.

released.description: Count of LIVE seats reclaimed (0 is a valid idempotent success).

seat_ids.description: The reclaimed seat_ids (sorted; exactly one per released seat).

results.description: Mixed-type results across customers/licenses/entitlements/orders. `type` + `id` let the UI deep-link.

id.description: Deep-link key: customer id, license id, encoded entitlement id, or subscription id.

request_id.description: From cf-ray, else a generated UUID.

TimeseriesData.description: Bucketed usage-analytics over [from,to). `buckets` is a dense, fixed-length array (zero-filled gaps); each bucket aggregates usage_events (by ts) + order_events (by received_at).

bucket_seconds.description: Nominal bucket width; the last bucket absorbs any integer remainder of the span.

denial_rate.description: denials / (checkouts + denials); 0 when the bucket saw no attempts (the upsell signal).

releases.description: usage_events event_type IN ('release','reclaim') in this bucket.

WebhookDelivery.description: A row in the webhook_deliveries outbox (drained by the backend cron). The payload body is not surfaced; only delivery metadata.

last_status.description: HTTP status of the last attempt (0 if never attempted).

WebhookEndpoint.description: A webhook endpoint config row (webhook_endpoints). The signing secret is NEVER stored here — it lives only in the Worker-env WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRETS map.

event_types.description: CSV event-type filter; empty string means all event types.

scope_customer_id.description: Per-tenant scope (audit R2.2). null/'' = global; matches customer events. Set one dimension, not both.

scope_project.description: Per-tenant scope (audit R2.2). null/'' = global; matches entitlement/order events. Set one dimension, not both.

url.description: Delivery URL. Always https (a non-https URL is rejected at create/patch with 400 invalid_url).

WebhookEndpointInput.description: Create body. `url` is required and MUST be https. event_types / description / scope_* take the column default ('').

scope_customer_id.description: Per-tenant scope (audit R2.2). '' = global. Set one dimension, not both.

scope_project.description: Per-tenant scope (audit R2.2). '' = global. Set one dimension, not both.

url.description: https URL. A non-https or unparseable URL returns 400 invalid_url.

WebhookEndpointPatch.description: All fields optional; only provided fields are updated. status / id are NOT patchable (status flips only via disable/reenable).

url.description: https URL. A non-https URL returns 400 invalid_url.

cloudflareAccess.description: Cloudflare Access JWT, verified against the configured issuer/audience/JWKS. The email claim is mapped to a role via ADMIN_ACCESS_ADMIN_EMAILS / ADMIN_ACCESS_READER_EMAILS. Reads allow reader or admin; mutations require admin.
cloudflareAccess.name: cf-access-jwt-assertion

devBearer.description: Development-only bearer token (ADMIN_DEV_BEARER, gated by ADMIN_DEV_BEARER_ENABLED). Grants the admin role. Returns 500 dev_bearer_forbidden_in_environment if enabled outside ENVIRONMENT=development. Not for production use.

syncBearer.description: Bearer token for /api/sync/entitlements, compared (timing-safe) against SYNC_API_TOKEN. Independent of Cloudflare Access; no reader/admin distinction.

info.description: Operator back-office API for managing entitlements, customers, licenses, and orders. All /api/admin/* routes require Cloudflare Access JWT (reader or admin RBAC); mutations require the admin role. /api/sync/entitlements uses a separate bearer token (SYNC_API_TOKEN). Every response is the flat envelope { ok, code, request_id, data? }.
